weeks.title: Python syntax and control flow
weeks.focus: Types, expressions, conditions, loops, collections, functions

days.outline: Install Python, editor; run scripts; explain variables/types.
Write type conversion, conditions and operators exercises.
Solve eight loop and iteration problems.
Manipulate lists, dictionaries, sets and strings.
Write reusable functions and test five cases.
BUILD: CLI Contact Manager with add/search/edit/delete.

weeks.checkpoint: Uses functions and collections; handles missing contacts gracefully.

weeks.title: Python modules, files and OOP
weeks.focus: Packages, exceptions, JSON/CSV, classes and type hints

days.outline: Use virtualenv and install a dependency.
Read/write JSON and CSV with safe error handling.
Add type hints, comprehensions and generators.
BUILD: JSON Expense Tracker with CSV export.

weeks.checkpoint: Persists across runs and reports malformed files.

weeks.title: Practical Python engineering
weeks.focus: Typing, tests, logging, profiling and async introduction

days.outline: Structure a Python package and configure logs.
Add pytest and debug a failing function.
Experiment with asyncio coroutines and await.
Retrieve JSON from a public API, validate input.
BUILD: CLI API Data Fetcher with tests.

weeks.checkpoint: Uses defensive exception handling and at least ten tests.

weeks.title: HTTP and networking fundamentals
weeks.focus: DNS, TLS, request-response, cookies and headers

days.outline: Inspect TCP, ports, HTTPS and TLS.
Read HTTP headers and JSON bodies in DevTools.
Trace cookies, sessions, status and proxies.
Send curl requests and classify status codes.
BUILD: HTTP request inspector and cheat sheet.

weeks.checkpoint: Explains request/response lifecycle and common status codes.

weeks.title: Git, API tooling and REST design
weeks.focus: Version control, Postman, endpoint naming and method semantics

days.outline: Initialize Git repo and make clean commits.
Clone, branch, merge, resolve a conflict.
Run API requests in Postman and curl.
Design resources, methods and error responses.
Create versioned API spec and Postman collection.
BUILD: Task API contract with ten requests.

weeks.checkpoint: Complete README, Postman collection and endpoint schema.

weeks.title: First working REST API
weeks.focus: Basic FastAPI CRUD with no database

days.outline: Run a FastAPI app and view /docs.
Validate bodies, path values and HTTP errors.
Test success and error cases manually/automatically.

weeks.checkpoint: Independent CRUD implementation; correct 201/204/404 behavior.

weeks.title: FastAPI core
weeks.focus: ASGI, routes, query/path validation, APIRouter and docs

days.outline: Understand ASGI vs HTTP and run server.
Create path and query parameter routes.
Define request/response models and status codes.
Inspect Swagger UI, OpenAPI and error responses.

weeks.checkpoint: CRUD endpoints plus OpenAPI response examples.

weeks.title: Pydantic for reliable APIs
weeks.focus: Typed schemas, nested validation and controlled responses

days.outline: Use Field constraints and strict values.
Create nested objects and custom validators.
Serialize, exclude secrets and use model config.

weeks.checkpoint: Invalid data rejected, sensitive fields never returned.

weeks.title: FastAPI dependencies and middleware
weeks.focus: Depends, lifespan, CORS, settings, logging

days.outline: Create logging middleware and CORS policy.
Handle custom exceptions and lifespan events.
Build upload endpoint and typed settings.

weeks.checkpoint: Trace middleware order and dependency cleanup.

weeks.title: REST API design for real clients
weeks.focus: Pagination, contracts, errors and idempotency

days.outline: Write OpenAPI examples and contract tests.

weeks.checkpoint: Consistent API design and deterministic pagination.

weeks.title: FastAPI multi-module integration
weeks.focus: Composition, pagination, refactoring, test seams

days.outline: Split project into routers, schema and configuration.
Add basic unit/API tests and API docs.
BUILD: Refactor Product Catalog to modular app.

weeks.checkpoint: At least 15 tested endpoints and readable structure.

weeks.title: FastAPI level assessment
weeks.focus: Independent project build with validation and docs

days.outline: Review weak spots in routes and Pydantic.
Implement CRUD for an unfamiliar entity.
Add pagination, error handling and middleware.
Write tests and short API consumer guide.

weeks.checkpoint: No tutorial copying, tests demonstrate important errors.

weeks.title: SQL fundamentals
weeks.focus: PostgreSQL setup and CRUD queries

days.outline: Install PostgreSQL and create a role/database.
Use filters, sorting, limit and NULL semantics.
Apply aggregations, GROUP BY and HAVING.

weeks.title: Advanced SQL and relationships
weeks.focus: JOINs, CTEs, windows, isolation introduction

days.outline: Use nested queries and correlated subqueries.

weeks.checkpoint: 15 analytical queries including ranking and JOINs.

Create B-tree, GIN and partial indexes.
Simulate locks/deadlock safely in local DB.

weeks.checkpoint: Reports actual query plan and controlled benchmark setup.

weeks.focus: Models, sessions, relationships and transactions

days.outline: Create engine and SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM models.
Define session dependency and read records.
Detect N+1 and try eager loading.

weeks.checkpoint: Safe session lifecycle and constraints on persistent data.

weeks.title: Alembic and database optimization
weeks.focus: Schema migrations, N+1, pools and backups

days.outline: Create Alembic environment and initial revision.
Inspect connection pool and eager loading.
BUILD: Inventory API with tracked migrations.

weeks.checkpoint: Clean database can be recreated via migrations.

weeks.title: Database final project
weeks.focus: Transactions, relationships, reporting and integrity

days.outline: Model products, stock, suppliers and warehouses.
Add indexes and query plan checks.
Test rollback, uniqueness and edge cases.

weeks.checkpoint: ERD and integration tests for stock integrity.

Set up Authorization Code + PKCE test provider.

weeks.focus: RBAC, ownership checks and threat modeling

days.outline: Enforce object ownership on every resource.
Review OWASP BOLA and injection attacks.
Configure CORS, CSRF and rate limits.
Write negative tests for privilege escalation.

weeks.checkpoint: Cross-user ID manipulation cannot disclose/alter data.

weeks.focus: Pytest, TestClient, fixtures and database isolation

days.outline: Create pytest fixtures and parametrized tests.
Use HTTPX async tests and mocks.
Add security, error and regression cases.

weeks.checkpoint: Tests all critical authorization flows and database boundaries.

weeks.title: Clean architecture
weeks.focus: Separating transport, domain and persistence

days.outline: Identify coupling and SOLID code smells.
Add exception boundaries and transaction ownership.
Apply Ruff, typing and code review checklist.

weeks.checkpoint: Business-rule change does not require HTTP layer edits.

weeks.title: Security + architecture assessment
weeks.focus: Refactoring, verification and review

days.outline: Improve test isolation and negative tests.
Add audit logging for sensitive actions.
Run full test and security checks.

weeks.checkpoint: Strong permission tests and explanatory architecture README.

days.outline: Experiment with asyncio tasks and gather.
Benchmark I/O concurrency and diagnose blocking.

weeks.focus: Caching, queues, retries and idempotent jobs

days.outline: Add worker retry/backoff and failure paths.

weeks.checkpoint: Retries do not duplicate business effects.

weeks.title: Real-time APIs and webhooks
weeks.focus: WebSockets, SSE and signature validation

days.outline: Verify signed webhook and timestamp tolerance.

weeks.checkpoint: Authenticated fanout and webhook replay defense.

weeks.focus: Scaling, cache, queues, consistency and failures

days.outline: Sketch load balancing and stateless scaling.
Study outbox, eventual consistency and sagas.

weeks.focus: Orders, stock, cache, job processing and payments

days.outline: Build order endpoints and valid state transitions.
Cache read-heavy product data and use queues.

weeks.checkpoint: Repeated callbacks never duplicate fulfillment.

weeks.title: Distributed systems assessment
weeks.focus: Benchmarking, reliability and tradeoffs

days.outline: Profile slow sync vs async endpoints.
Inject job queue failure and recovery.

weeks.checkpoint: Recorded benchmarks, tests and failure handling.

weeks.title: Docker and repeatability
weeks.focus: Images, Compose, networking, volumes, health checks

days.outline: Connect API, Postgres, Redis with Compose.
Create health checks and harden images.

weeks.checkpoint: Clean machine runs documented compose startup.

weeks.focus: GitHub Actions, secrets, HTTPS and release safety

days.outline: Write CI workflow for lint and tests.
Deploy via reverse proxy with HTTPS.

weeks.title: Observability and operations
weeks.focus: Logs, metrics, traces, SLOs and backups

days.outline: Add JSON logs and request correlation.
Define SLO, exercise DB restore and incident response.

weeks.focus: Vacuum, PgBouncer, EXPLAIN, load tests

weeks.focus: Production deployment, incident simulation and portfolio

days.outline: Run backup restore and rollback exercise.
